## 2. Avoid

- **Also avoid:** Buying vendor-awarded 'Certified AI Consultant' certificates (avoid per T0-68 G4); competing solely on generic marketplace race-to-the-bottom hourly rates without a vertical case study

## 3. Types that do not apply

- **Library / package:** specific libraries follow the client stack
- **Specialised product:** observability and eval products follow the client's existing contracts
- **Hardware / accelerator:** GPU hardware bring-up is a specialist infra contract
- **Regulation / framework:** formal regulatory sign-off sits with client legal and governance
- **Research craft:** novel ML research is not standard in contract delivery

## 4. Credentials (tie-breakers, not skills)

- **Optional:** Google Professional Agentic Architect (PAA): Optional cloud-partner credibility for GCP agentic client deliveries (MCP + A2A + 2 labs; GA mid-Nov 2026) [A · T3-01, T0-66] [T0-66]
- **Optional:** AWS Certified Generative AI Developer – Professional (AIP-C01): Optional signal for AWS enterprise contract bids (23.2% UK GenAI contracts name AWS) [B · T0-66 L625, T3-01] [T0-66]
- **Optional:** Microsoft AI-103 (Azure AI apps and agents): Optional signal for Azure enterprise contract bids (29.7% UK GenAI contracts name Azure; status provisional pending T0-28) [B · T0-66 L620] [T0-11, T0-66]

## 5. Prerequisites and proof

- **Prerequisites:** Proven production shipping record (typically 5+ years engineering/ML) plus client acquisition channel (warm network, specialist staffing or referral; avoid relying on unverified 92% referral claims — independent surveys show 53-75%, T0-66).
- **Proof to show:** Two to three anonymised client case studies with before/after latency, cost or workflow-time metrics, clean handover docs, and one public category-level evaluation or agent blueprint.
- **Posting terms (measured or cited):** Python, LLM, RAG, AI agents, Azure, AWS, GCP, LangGraph, MCP, MLOps, CI/CD, evaluations, stakeholder management, production delivery.
